description: This PHP file defines the LeaveModel class within the OrangeHRM Leave API module. The class models leave data, including properties like id, date, duration, status, leave type, start/end times, duration type, and last comment. It implements serialization behavior and constructs API schema definitions with annotations.

classes.name: LeaveModel
classes.description: A model class representing leave data in the OrangeHRM API, including properties such as id, date, duration, status, types, times, comments, and associated leave request information. Implements normalizable for serialization and includes OA schema annotations for API documentation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LeaveModel with a Leave entity, setting serialization filters and attribute mappings.
